This is a senior backend engineering role at Coinbase on the institutional financing team, building the systems that manage institutional crypto loans across products like Portfolio Margin, Trade Finance, and Agency Lending. The work centers on backend services and APIs for loan lifecycle management, risk calculation, and real-time position tracking, where correctness and data integrity matter at scale. The core stack is Go and Java with gRPC/Protobuf, relational data stores, and distributed systems in a cloud environment.
